summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a mandatory notification of trade under EU Market Abuse Regulation. CEO Lars-Christian Svensen acquired 4,000 shares at NOK 131.36 per share on May 22, 2026, increasing his holdings to 23,186 shares plus 185,000 options. This is a routine PDMR share acquisition, not a special situation. No strategic corporate event, M&A, activist, or restructuring is involved.
